Title: HTC-28042: CAN Communication - Bus Impedance
Purpose: Check if the CAN interfaces are terminated with 120 ohms (+/-5%) and split termination technic.

Inputs.1: CAN FD A: Signals CAN_A_P & CAN_A_N.
Inputs.2: CAN FD B: Signals CAN_B_P & CAN_B_N.

1.Expected: The bus impedance between these pins shall be of 120 ohms, with split resistor termination technic.
